title: SAR Doppler tomography paper on Vesuvius with the National Research Council of Italy

tellings.quote: um under the Vesuvius and I wrote a paper was very very nice paper and

plain: A scientist named Filippo Biondi, known on the show for scanning beneath the pyramids, says that in 2019 he wrote a paper with the National Research Council of Italy on what lies under Mount Vesuvius near Naples, using a method that turns satellite radar signals into images of what is underground. He tells it first-hand, calling it "a very very nice paper," as an earlier test of the same technique he later used elsewhere.
